notable_absence.finding: Individual Prometheus metrics on this page each carry an explicit version badge (e.g. sgw_cache_revision_cache_num_items at '3.2.1', sgw_database_total_sync_time at '3.2.0', sgw_audit_num_audits_logged at '3.2.1') - a per-metric availableSince fact repeated roughly 150 times across the page. Not minted as individual relations here: the round's guidance is against exhaustively extracting every reference-table row, and a per-metric availableSince relation for each of ~150 stats would overwhelm the record without adding ontological insight beyond 'this specific counter shipped in this specific patch version' - noted here as a deliberate scope decision rather than an oversight.

cross_component_finding: sgw_database_num_tombstones_compacted ('Number of tombstones compacted through tombstone compaction task on the database') is this page's own independent naming of the sgw:compact-operation's tombstone mode (minted in revisions.json) as a background 'task' - a third piece of vocabulary (alongside revisions.md's REST-triggered /{db}/_compact and stats-monitoring-json.md's compaction_tombstone_start_time timestamp) describing the same underlying mechanism from three different angles (operation, timing, count) across three different pages in this one batch, none of which cross-reference each other explicitly.
cross_product_finding: This page states outright that Sync Gateway follows the same pattern as the rest of the product line: 'Like other Couchbase services, Sync Gateway offers Prometheus-compatible metrics in a flat JSON format' - the same isAnalogousTo family-resemblance statement already captured in stats-monitoring.json, restated here almost verbatim, confirming it is a stable, repeated framing across this sub-page group rather than a one-off phrasing.
